FIFA World Cup matches and related reports covered by Indian media

Multiple Indian media outlets covered various matches and related news from the FIFA World Cup. Reports focused on specific team matchups, player milestones, and tournament schedules. One outlet also highlighted a significant rise in online hate comments during the World Cup.

  • Centre (5): Deccan Chronicle, Deccan Herald, Mathrubhumi English, The Indian Express, The Tribune
  • Right (2): India Today, Republic World
